answer: Comet-trail attribution pooling.** Each wallet's actions emit a signed event log; operators must periodically submit a ferrous anchor—a hardware-attested digest binding all wallets they control into one pool, enforced by withholding settlement for unanchored activity. An attacker spinning up N wallets pays N anchor fees plus the per-pool compliance audit, and a flagged sybil pool loses its entire ocean of pooled settlement rights, not just the offending wallet. Cost scales with operators, not addresses.
